title: On the Court
description: Members of Jeddah United, the first Saudi sports league to include athletes of both genders, practice basketball. The company was founded in 2003 by Lina Khaled Almaeena and is training academy and sports league for both basketball and soccer. Photographer Lynsey Addario has spent more than a decade documenting the life of women in Saudi Arabia. “I want people to learn—to have a better sense of what Saudi women’s lives are,” she told National Geographic in 2016. “I hope people walk away with a different perspective.”
translated_description: 吉达联合体育联盟是沙特首个男女运动员同场竞技的体育联盟，其成员正在进行篮球训练。该公司由莉娜·哈立德·阿尔马伊纳于2003年创立，是一家集篮球和足球于一体的训练学院及体育联盟。摄影师琳赛·阿达里奥花了十多年时间记录沙特阿拉伯女性的生活。“我希望人们能够了解——更深入地了解沙特女性的生活，”她在2016年告诉《国家地理》杂志，“我希望人们离开时能带着不同的视角。”
